note: Franky's notebook. Written by the duck itself (the model's weights never change). tries = attempts the note was shown in, wins = how many of those succeeded.

knowledge.text: Successful pickup requires the banana to be within 0.03 m of the beak tip.
The vision model often fails to locate the green box, even when it is visible in the environment.
Successful pickup occurred when the banana was 0.02 m right of the beak tip, and its long side pointed +73 degrees.

skills.text: To pick up, align closely and ensure the banana is within 0.05 m of the beak tip before closing.
If the vision model fails to find a target, rely on the last known coordinates or visual confirmation.
